# Rameez Khan — rameez.co

> Personal site of Rameez Khan, a Senior Data Engineer based in London, UK.
> The site has writing, notes, projects, a knowledge graph, an AI assistant
> ("Node"), and a typing game.

Rameez Khan is a Senior Data Engineer at RVU (Aug 2023–present), where he
builds data ingestion pipelines with Argo Workflows and Terraform, built a
TypeScript/RxJS/Kubernetes transformation pipeline that cut product publish
time from hours to seconds, and mentors engineers. Previously: Data Engineer
at RVU (2021–2023, dbt modularisation, 50% GCP cost reduction, Dagster→Argo
migration), Data Engineer and Data Analyst at Mobkoi (2018–2021, serverless
GCP pipelines, BigQuery warehouse with dbt), and Industrial Engineer at
Schneider Electric (2015–2017).

Certifications: Google Cloud Professional Data Engineer (2022), Google Cloud
Professional Cloud Architect (2020).
Education: BEng (Hons) Chemical and Nuclear Engineering, University of Leeds.
Languages: Python, SQL, JavaScript/TypeScript, Go.
Technologies: GCP, BigQuery, dbt, Terraform, Kubernetes, Argo, Dagster,
Airflow, AWS, Postgres, MySQL, Prometheus, Monte Carlo.
